summary.text: Bill Fincher is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 23 who took office in January 2026 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Fincher ran in the 2020 Republican primary runoff for Georgia House District 21, which he lost to Brad Thomas on August 11, 2020.

In 2025 he was one of six candidates in the December 9 special general election for District 23, finishing first with 27.4% of the vote, and he defeated Democrat Scott Sanders in the January 6, 2026 special general runoff.
Ballotpedia lists his assumption of office as January 10, 2026, succeeding Mandi Ballinger.
Fincher advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary without opposition and faces Democrat Rob Epstein in the general election.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
